basics.summary: Senior software development manager with over 25 years of extensive development experience spanning software globalization and localization, middleware platforms (IBM WebSphere), enterprise social software (IBM Connections), enterprise storage observability software (Virtual Storage Analytics), and storage automation software (Terraform and Ansible). work.name: Xincere Med
work.summary: Engaged in R&D management and quality system development for eCOA/ePData clinical research software.
highlights: Responsible for R&D management and testing team management of the company's eCOA/ePData platform, covering recruiting and interviewing, performance goal setting, competency matrix development, 1-on-1 coaching, and talent development

Led the establishment of the Computerized System Validation (CSV) system: authored the CSV SOP and iterated it (v2.0 → v3.0 → v3.1, with v4.0 planned), built a template library of validation process node deliverables, and drove the full set of deliverables for ePData v3.1 from Validation Plan (VP), User Requirements Specification (URS), Risk Assessment (RA), functional/design/configuration specifications to IQ/OQ/PQ test cases and Requirements Traceability Matrix (RTM), including authoring, review, and sign-off

Drafted the R&D department SOP system (CSV, SDLC, Security, BCP&DR), participated in the company's QMS quality system remediation, and was responsible for the formulation, review, and updating of basic risk control policies and the AI Policy

Represented the R&D department in responding to customer and third-party inspections/audits (Merck (MSD), PPD, CSPC, Hansoh, Kainuo, ICON, etc.), explained product features and SDLC/CSV processes, provided scenario-based test evidence, and was responsible for CAPA formulation, fishbone root cause analysis, and response closure

Advanced AI-enabled R&D: researched and implemented GitLab issue/ZenTao defect management agent skills (issue-fix, zentao-bug-fix, zentao-testcase-operations, document conversion skills), defined the defect management process, and promoted AI tool adoption across the testing team through survey research, training, and tool configuration

Responsible for open source compliance and security governance: established SBOM and open source license reporting mechanisms, and organized SCA/SAST scanning, vulnerability remediation, and penetration testing

Responsible for DevOps infrastructure and toolchain development: Kubernetes cluster expansion, GitLab CI pipeline parallelization rework, and integration of the defect management system with code repositories

Responsible for cloud resources and delivery infrastructure: Alibaba Cloud ECS/SLB/EIP/MongoDB selection and procurement, and planning and deployment of the ePayment WeChat Mini Program server environment
achievements: The CSV SOP system was approved by QA and the CEO (v3.0) and iterated to v3.1; all VP/URS/RA and specification documents for ePData v3.1 were reviewed and signed on schedule, and the v2.7.0 validation summary report was signed off

Supported the Merck (MSD) supplier onboarding audit and the PPD audit: delivered v3 product demo videos, screenshot evidence of scenario-specific test cases, and training materials, and responded throughout to inquiries on R&D processes and the quality system

Led the CAPA for 6 findings (3 major / 3 other) from the ICON supplier onboarding audit, completed fishbone root cause analysis and remediation responses; drove the upgrade of the SDLC SOP to 8.0 to meet the 9.30 effective date requirement of the Hansoh CAPA
Upgraded ZenTao across versions from 12.4.1 to 22.2, achieving end-to-end traceability between defects and code changes (commit messages containing bug#xxx are automatically linked)
Cleared all critical/high dependency vulnerabilities in the v3 product, and delivered the complete audit evidence package of SBOM, OSS licenses, SCA/SAST, and penetration testing in a single pass
AI agent skills were implemented, automating the full workflow from Issue/ZenTao defects to fix code and MRs, and enabling batch import of test case documents into ZenTao

Closed the loop on test engineer recruiting (multiple rounds of resume screening and interviews), and completed the establishment of the testing team's H2 2026 performance metrics and competency development matrix
